_comment: Run template for bts (CC BY 4.0: cite Prabowo et al., NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks and the dataset record, catalog id bts). One facility per site (`camber datasets config bts --facility ds-bts-a` picks one; default: the first ingested, site B for the default subset). Points are grouped into equipment by their Brick owner, and only points whose Brick class maps cleanly to a CAMBER role are ingested, so most equipment carries one to four roles: site B's air handlers have discharge-air temperature, outdoor-air damper position, filter pressure drop and outdoor-air temperature, but no valve, fan status or setpoint. No fault rule runs by default: every rule needs a fan status or a valve that the mapped points do not provide, and the data has no fault labels. Use the RCx report's sensor-health section (range violations, flatlines, gaps and trust per point); the three sites are also the evaluation set of the time-series point-role suggester (examples/suggester_eval).
